title: security(rbac): RBAC v2 enforce KMS region pinning, audit logging, and data residency controls
author: Ethan Zhao
description:
Motivation: Close gaps between RBAC v2 policy evaluation and customer KMS/data-residency requirements. This PR implements enforce-mode for KMS region pinning, surfaces audit log events for region/policy violations, and adds controls for data residency enforcement. The goal is to let platform operators opt into strict residency enforcement while preserving an audit-only rollout path.

Summary of changes: adds server-side enforcement for rbac.kms_region pinning, audit log events for policy evaluation results (rbac.evaluate and rbac.violation), migration scripts to annotate existing KMS bindings, new unit/integration tests, and console/CLI flags to toggle enforcement. New config: rbac.v2.enforce_kms_region (boolean) and rbac.v2.audit_on_violation (boolean). When enforcement is disabled, violations are logged and metrics emitted; when enabled, requests that violate residency return 403 with structured error code RBAC_KMS_REGION_VIOLATION and are recorded in audit logs for compliance.

Checklist: [x] Design doc linked (internal: https://linear.app/ENG/board/ENG-4091) [x] Unit tests for policy evaluator [x] Integration tests for KMS binding checks and installer flow [x] Migration script to annotate existing keys [x] Docs updated (rbac docs + private installer notes) [x] Rollout plan included [x] Alerting and metrics added

Testing and verification: ran full CI, added integration tests that spin up a minimal policy server and fake KMS metadata service to validate region pin checks. Manual validation performed against staging with Canary group using a dedicated tenant. Verified audit events appear in the audit stream (event type: rbac.violation, fields: principal, action, resource, expected_region, observed_region, policy_id).

Rollout plan: 1) Deploy to staging with rbac.v2.enforce_kms_region=false and audit_on_violation=true for 48h. 2) Monitor metrics (rbac.violation_count, rbac.enforced_denials) and console error rates for 24h. 3) Toggle enforcement for 5% tenants for 6h, monitor, then 25%, 100% over 24-48h. Revert path: flip rbac.v2.enforce_kms_region=false; incidents will be diagnosed using audit logs and the migration script.

Backward compatibility and migration: default is audit-only to avoid breaking existing customers. The migration annotates KMSKey resources with region-residency metadata (key_residency: "eu-west-1" etc.). Private installer will respect the same config and validation during upgrades.

Security notes: error messages intentionally obfuscate internal policy IDs in public API errors and rely on structured audit payloads for compliance teams. Added unit tests asserting that no sensitive fields are emitted in API responses.

Related: previous work on RBAC v2 audit-mode and KMS integrations (see PRs: pr-70621, pr-76288, pr-80321).
